title: DesignSystemComponent:WorkflowCanvas

_meta.purpose: Node-edge authoring canvas for durable Workflow definitions with explicit state, branch, join, capability-call, and jurisdiction-overlay affordances.

purpose: Node-edge authoring canvas for durable Workflow definitions with explicit state, branch, join, capability-call, and jurisdiction-overlay affordances.

accessibility.keyboard: 100% keyboard authoring through palette, node traversal, edge creation, delete, and save; no mouse-only graph operations
accessibility.screen_reader: announces selected node, inbound/outbound edges, validation status, and overlay scope through a structured outline mirror

security_invariants: canvas never renders LLM-authored spec until schema validation succeeds
tenant, cell, and jurisdiction overlays remain visible before save
destructive graph edits require undo snapshot and audit-safe diff summary
